subject: Tenant retention carveout & evidence timeline (EU edge tenant)
messages:
From: Julie Hart <julie.hart@novapath.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:14:00+00:00
Subject: Request: EU tenant retention exception & evidence pack

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. Novapath is finalizing a customer due diligence review and we have a regulatory requirement to document a shortened retention window for one EU tenant (customer reference: NP-EU-45). The tenant is requesting a TTL of 14 days for session/debug traces vs Redwood's standard 90 days for our hosted offering.

For our audit team to accept the exception, we need:
- a retention matrix showing tenant-scoped TTLs and how they map to backup/replication windows;
- proof that deletion is executed (sample proof-of-delete artifacts);
- sample SOC 2 log exports demonstrating the deletion workflow (redacted as necessary);
- confirmation of how ephemeral KV cache or model traces are excluded from long-term stores;
- a signed DPA addendum or guidance on DocuSign steps to operationalize the exception.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an evidence bundle and an estimated delivery date? Ideally the audit team wants artifacts in 7 business days.

Appreciate a quick acknowledgement.

Regards,
Julie Hart
Head of Security Assurance
Novapath

Attachments: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julie Hart <julie.hart@novapath.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T10:02:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU tenant retention exception & evidence pack

Julie — thanks for the clear ask.

Acknowledged. Internal owners below are looped to compile the evidence: Priyom will pull the retention mappings and proof-of-delete artifacts; Kimberly will confirm compliance posture and the DPA addendum path.

Proposed delivery: 4 business days for an initial evidence bundle (retention matrix + sample proofs + SOC2 sampling PDF). If we need any redlines to the DPA we'll surface those as a separate DocuSign package. Are you OK with that cadence?

To be explicit, we'll include the following in the first drop:
- retention-matrix.csv (tenant + backup/replica windows)
- soc2-sample-logs.pdf (redacted exports showing deletion events)
- proof-of-delete-checklist.docx (procedural notes and sample transaction ids)
- short readme that maps CAIQ/SIG items to artifacts (where applicable)

If Novapath needs an executed addendum before the artifacts land, we can also prioritize a DocuSign route but that may add an extra business day.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference

---
On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 09:14 Julie Hart <julie.hart@novapath.com> wrote:
> Hi Grace,
> 
> Thanks for taking this. Novapath is finalizing a customer due diligence review ...
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Julie Hart <julie.hart@novapath.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:37:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU tenant retention exception & evidence pack

Julie / Grace — quick technical note on what we'll include and limitations.

What I will produce by EOD (4 business days):
1) retention-matrix.csv — tenant row for NP-EU-45 showing: session TTL (14d requested), debug/traces default (90d), backup retention (30d immutable snapshot tier) and cross-region replica TTL (30d), plus the deletion propagation timeline (jobs + queue processing).
2) soc2-sample-logs.pdf — two redacted exports: (a) deletion job trigger for tenant NP-EU-45, (b) confirmation record from object store showing object tombstone + final purge event.
3) proof-of-delete-checklist.docx — procedural checklist, sample transaction ids, and links to internal runbooks.
4) small shell script we used for mass-assertion (attachment stub: delete-assertion-sample.sh) — note: we won't send production keys or secrets.

Caveats:
- Backups are snapshot-based; final immutability window may be subject to provider-side replication; we will include the exact retention/replica TTLs and the compensating control (accelerated purge request process) for the snapshot tier.
- We cannot produce full raw logs for privacy reasons; only redacted samples and event IDs that can be matched to our audit trail.

I'll attach the artifacts as filenames in the bundle. If Novapath needs signed attestation beyond the artifacts (e.g., an engineer-signed statement), flag that and we'll include a short statement.

Priyom Das
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments (to follow): retention-matrix.csv, soc2-sample-logs.pdf, proof-of-delete-checklist.docx, delete-assertion-sample.sh

---
On Thu, Nov 18, 2026 at 10:02 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Julie — thanks for the clear ask....
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Julie Hart <julie.hart@novapath.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:21:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU tenant retention exception & evidence pack

Julie — quick compliance note from my side.

We can support a tenant-scoped TTL of 14 days for session and debug traces provided Novapath signs the standard DPA addendum that enumerates the exception and the compensating controls. For SOC 2 / CAIQ mapping:
- SOC 2: include the redacted log exports and proof-of-delete artifacts as evidence for CC6/CC7 related controls.
- CAIQ: we'll provide a short mapping doc that points to the artifacts (e.g., CAIQ section 3.3: Logging & Monitoring => artifact: soc2-sample-logs.pdf).

Operational note: once the addendum is executed, our ops team will set a tenant flag which will short-circuit the standard retention pipeline for NP-EU-45. Deletion propagation will still follow the same queue-based purge but with an accelerated schedule that Priyom has documented.

I'll coordinate the DocuSign send for the addendum unless Novapath would prefer to upload a redline first. If you want to review the addendum language before we route it, I can share the draft.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Regulatory & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Julie Hart <julie.hart@novapath.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T16:42:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU tenant retention exception & evidence pack

Thanks Grace, Priyom and Kimberly — that plan works for us. 

A couple small clarifications before you send the bundle:
- Please include a list of 3 sample object ids (tombstone + final purge) we can reference in our internal acceptance tests.
- The audit team would like the CAIQ mapping as a single page summary if possible.
- We would prefer the DPA redline before DocuSign; I'll upload our redline to the Drive folder you provided by EOD tomorrow.

Once we receive the initial bundle we will run a short review and circle back if we need additional attestation. Appreciate the rapid response.

Julie Hart
Head of Security Assurance
Novapath
